title: Logical Access — Asset Inventory
description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events to meet the entity's objectives.
guidance: Evidence: IAM user inventory, role inventory, access key list with last-used dates. All principals should be accounted for and actively used.

title: Logical Access — Credential Registration
description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users whose access is administered by the entity.
guidance: Evidence: No root access keys present. Each user holds at most one active access key. Programmatic access is scoped to purpose.

title: Logical Access — Access Removal
description: The entity removes access to protected information assets when appropriate (e.g., the individual is no longer associated with the entity).
guidance: Evidence: No IAM users inactive beyond threshold. No access keys unused beyond threshold. No roles unassumed beyond threshold. Root account not used for routine operations.

title: Logical Access — External Threat Controls
description: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries, including MFA enforcement, least privilege, and network perimeter controls.
guidance: Evidence: MFA enabled for root and all IAM console users. No wildcard Action in role policies. No wildcard trust principals. S3 public access blocked. No security groups allow unrestricted SSH or RDP. RDS instances are not publicly accessible.

title: Logical Access — Transmission Encryption
description: The entity restricts the transmission of confidential information to authorized internal and external users and protects it during transmission.
guidance: Evidence: S3 buckets enforce HTTPS-only via bucket policy (aws:SecureTransport condition). Load balancer listeners use modern TLS security policies.

title: Logical Access — Encryption at Rest
description: The entity implements controls to prevent unauthorized access to data at rest through encryption of storage resources.
guidance: Evidence: S3 buckets encrypted with KMS. KMS keys have automatic annual rotation enabled. RDS instances and EBS volumes have storage encryption enabled.

title: System Operations — Configuration Change Detection
description: To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail enabled with log file validation and KMS encryption in all regions.

title: System Operations — Anomaly Detection
description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives.
guidance: Evidence: GuardDuty and Security Hub enabled in all regions. VPC Flow Logs enabled on all VPCs. Lambda functions have Dead Letter Queues configured so failed invocations are captured.

title: Change Management — Authorized Changes
description: The entity authorizes, approves, and communicates changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its change management objectives.
guidance: Evidence: Branch protection on default branches. Required PR approvals before merge. No self-merges. Protected deployment environments require designated approvers.

title: Maintain current contact details
description: AWS account contact information must be current for billing and security notifications.
guidance: Complete primary contact in AWS Console → Account → Contact information.

title: Ensure security contact information is registered
description: A security alternate contact receives security notifications from AWS.
guidance: Register SECURITY alternate contact with email and phone in Account settings.

title: Ensure no root user access key exists
description: The root account is the most privileged AWS account. Access keys provide programmatic access and should not exist on root.
guidance: Delete any root access keys. Use IAM roles for programmatic access.

title: Ensure MFA is enabled for the root user
description: Multi-factor authentication adds an extra layer of protection on the root account.
guidance: Enable MFA on the root account (hardware MFA preferred for root).

title: Ensure hardware MFA is enabled for the root user
description: CIS recommends hardware MFA for root. Veritrail verifies MFA is enabled but cannot distinguish hardware vs virtual from IAM alone.
guidance: Manual attestation required: the IAM API does not distinguish hardware vs virtual MFA. Attach a hardware MFA device to root and attest, or document the virtual-MFA exception.

title: Eliminate use of the root user for administrative tasks
description: Root user activity should be rare and auditable.
guidance: Use IAM users and roles for daily operations; monitor CloudTrail for root usage.

title: Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
description: MFA adds an extra layer of protection on top of a username and password. With MFA enabled, when a user signs in to the AWS Management Console, they are prompted for their username and password plus an authentication code from their MFA device.
guidance: Enable MFA for every IAM user that has console access. Consider using IAM Identity Center for SSO instead of IAM users.

title: Ensure credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled
description: AWS IAM users can access AWS resources using different types of credentials. CIS requires that credentials unused for 45 days or greater are disabled.
guidance: Disable or remove IAM users with no console activity in 45+ days. Deactivate access keys unused for 45+ days, then delete after confirming no dependency. Veritrail detects against the CIS 45-day threshold; deactivation is performed in your AWS account.

title: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
description: Access keys consist of an access key ID and secret access key. Rotating access keys reduces the window of opportunity for keys that are compromised without your knowledge.
guidance: Create a new access key, update the consuming workload, then deactivate and delete the old key.

title: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
description: IAM password policies enforce complexity and minimum length for console users.
guidance: Automated check: iam.account.password_policy_weak

title: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
description: Password reuse prevention reduces risk from compromised credentials.
guidance: Automated check: iam.account.password_policy_weak (reuse prevention field).

title: Ensure IAM users receive permissions only through groups
description: By default, IAM users, groups, and roles have no access to AWS resources. Assigning policies directly to individual users is harder to manage at scale.
guidance: Remove directly-attached user policies and instead assign permissions via roles or groups.

title: Ensure IAM policies that allow full administrative privileges are not attached
description: IAM policies are the means by which privileges are granted to users, groups, or roles. Policies that grant full administrative privileges provide excessive and unnecessary permissions.
guidance: Replace policies with Allow Action: '*' and Resource: '*' (full admin) with scoped action lists and specific resource ARNs.

title: Ensure S3 Bucket Policy enforces HTTPS-only requests
description: S3 bucket policies should deny any HTTP request to protect data in transit from interception.
guidance: Add a bucket policy with a Deny statement on aws:SecureTransport: false.

title: Ensure S3 Block Public Access is enabled at account and bucket level
description: Amazon S3 Block Public Access provides controls to ensure that S3 resources do not allow public access. Enabling all four Block Public Access settings is recommended.
guidance: Enable BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, and RestrictPublicBuckets on every bucket and at the account level.

title: Ensure rotation for customer-created symmetric CMKs is enabled
description: AWS Key Management Service allows customers to rotate the backing key material for a customer-created customer master key. Automatic key rotation should be enabled.
guidance: Enable annual automatic rotation on all customer-managed KMS keys. AWS-managed keys rotate automatically and are not flagged.

title: Ensure unauthorized SSH/RDP access is restricted
description: Security groups must not allow unrestricted ingress on SSH (22) or RDP (3389) from the internet.
guidance: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 rules on ports 22 and 3389; use SSM Session Manager where possible.

title: Ensure EBS volumes are encrypted
description: EBS volume encryption protects data at rest using AWS KMS. Existing unencrypted volumes should be replaced with encrypted copies.
guidance: Create a snapshot of each unencrypted volume, copy the snapshot with encryption enabled, create a new encrypted volume, and replace the original during a maintenance window.

title: Ensure that encryption is enabled for RDS instances
description: Amazon RDS encrypted DB instances use the industry standard AES-256 encryption algorithm to encrypt data on the server that hosts the DB instance. Encryption at rest should be enabled for all RDS instances.
guidance: RDS encryption can only be set at creation time. To encrypt an existing unencrypted instance: take a snapshot, copy the snapshot with encryption enabled, restore to a new encrypted instance, then cut over traffic.

title: Ensure that public access is not given to RDS instances
description: Ensure and verify that RDS database instances provisioned in your AWS account do restrict unauthorized access by disabling the public accessibility configuration.
guidance: Modify the RDS instance to set 'Publicly Accessible' to No. Also ensure the instance is in a private subnet and the security group does not allow unrestricted inbound access.

title: Ensure RDS automated backups are enabled
description: RDS automated backups support point-in-time recovery and reduce the impact of accidental deletion, corruption, or failed migrations.
guidance: Set a backup retention period greater than zero for every production RDS instance.

title: User Registration and De-registration
description: Implement a formal user registration and de-registration process for granting and revoking access to all systems and services.
guidance: Evidence: IAM users are active and accounted for. Inactive users beyond 90 days are deprovisioned. Access keys are deactivated when no longer needed.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Management of Secret Authentication Information
description: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.
guidance: Evidence: Root and all console IAM users have MFA enabled. Account password policy enforces complexity and minimum length.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Review of User Access Rights
description: Asset owners shall review users' access rights at regular intervals to prevent privilege accumulation.
guidance: Evidence: No unassumed roles. Role permissions scoped to actively-used services. No wildcard actions or trust principals. Access keys used within 90 days.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: User Access Provisioning
description: User access to systems and services shall be provisioned in accordance with the access control policy.
guidance: Evidence: IAM users receive permissions via groups or roles, not direct policy attachment.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Secure Log-on Procedures
description: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.
guidance: Evidence: No root access keys exist. MFA is enforced for root and all console users. Only one active access key per user. Root account not used for routine operations.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Policy on the Use of Cryptographic Controls
description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protecting information shall be developed and implemented.
guidance: Evidence: S3 buckets have default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) enabled. KMS customer-managed keys have automatic rotation enabled. RDS storage is encrypted. EBS volumes are encrypted. EBS encryption-by-default is enabled in all regions.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Event Logging
description: Event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events shall be produced, kept and regularly reviewed.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail is enabled with multi-region logging. VPC flow logs are enabled. GuardDuty is active and detecting threats. Lambda functions have DLQs configured to capture silent failures.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Protection of Log Information
description: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorised access.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail log file integrity validation is enabled. CloudTrail logs are encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion and appropriate measures taken.
guidance: Evidence: Security Hub is enabled for centralised security findings. AWS Config maintains a continuous configuration change history. IAM Access Analyzer surfaces over-permissive cross-account access. ACM certificates are monitored before expiry. Lambda runtimes are kept current.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Network Controls
description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications from threats via the network.
guidance: Evidence: No security groups allow unrestricted SSH or RDP from 0.0.0.0/0. Default security groups have no inbound or outbound rules. VPC flow logs are enabled for network visibility. RDS instances are not publicly accessible.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Electronic Messaging
description: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected in transit.
guidance: Evidence: S3 buckets enforce HTTPS-only via aws:SecureTransport policy condition. Load balancer listeners use modern TLS security policies. Account-level and bucket-level S3 Block Public Access prevents accidental data exposure.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Ensure S3 buckets have default encryption enabled
description: Ensure S3 buckets have default encryption enabled
guidance: Automated check: s3.bucket.no_default_encryption

title: Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets
description: Ensure MFA Delete is enabled on S3 buckets
guidance: Automated check: s3.bucket.no_mfa_delete

title: Ensure S3 bucket access logging on CloudTrail bucket
description: Access logging on the CloudTrail S3 bucket supports forensic review of bucket access.
guidance: Enable server access logging on the bucket that receives CloudTrail logs.

title: Ensure S3 bucket used for CloudTrail is not publicly accessible
description: The CloudTrail log bucket must not allow public read or write.
guidance: Block public access on the trail bucket; verify bucket policy and ACLs.

title: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
description: AWS CloudTrail records API activity for security monitoring and audit evidence.
guidance: Enable a multi-region trail with management events. Re-scan after enabling.

title: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
description: Log file validation detects tampering with delivered CloudTrail logs.
guidance: Enable log file validation on each trail.

title: Ensure CloudTrail logs are encrypted at rest with KMS
description: CloudTrail S3 delivery should use a KMS CMK for encryption at rest.
guidance: Associate a KMS key with each trail; verify key policy allows CloudTrail.

title: Ensure a support role exists to manage incidents with AWS Support
description: A dedicated IAM role with AWSSupportAccess enables AWS Support case management.
guidance: Create a role with the AWS managed policy AWSSupportAccess for break-glass support access.

title: Ensure IAM instance roles are used for AWS resource access
description: Long-lived IAM user credentials on EC2 instances are discouraged; instance profiles are preferred.
guidance: Veritrail flags running instances with no IAM instance profile attached. Attach instance roles for AWS access; instances that never call AWS APIs can be snoozed with a note.

title: Ensure AWS Config is enabled
description: AWS Config records configuration changes for compliance monitoring.
guidance: Enable Config recorder and delivery channel in each active region.

title: Ensure default security groups restrict all traffic
description: The default security group in each VPC should not allow inbound or outbound traffic.
guidance: Remove all rules from default security groups; attach named groups to workloads.

title: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled
description: VPC Flow Logs capture network traffic metadata for detective controls.
guidance: Enable flow logs on each VPC or subnet per your logging architecture.

title: Ensure EC2 instances use IMDSv2
description: IMDSv2 mitigates SSRF-based credential theft from EC2 metadata.
guidance: Set HttpTokens to required on instance metadata options.

title: Ensure EBS default encryption is enabled
description: EBS encryption by default protects new volumes at rest.
guidance: Enable encryption by default in each region; migrate existing volumes as needed.

title: Ensure IAM Access Analyzer is enabled
description: Access Analyzer identifies unintended external access to IAM resources.
guidance: Enable Access Analyzer in each active region.

title: Ensure only one active access key per IAM user
description: Multiple active keys complicate rotation and ownership.
guidance: Deactivate and delete unused keys after validating workloads.

title: Ensure expired SSL/TLS certificates in IAM are removed
description: IAM server certificates past expiration should be removed.
guidance: Delete expired server certificates in IAM → Server certificates.

title: Ensure IAM password policy expires passwords within 90 days
description: Password maximum age limits credential lifetime.
guidance: Set MaxPasswordAge to 90 or fewer days in the account password policy.

title: Ensure access to AWSCloudShellFullAccess is restricted
description: CloudShell full access should not be attached broadly to users or roles.
guidance: Detach AWSCloudShellFullAccess except break-glass principals.

title: Ensure no customer-managed policy allows full admin (*:*)
description: Customer-managed policies must not grant Action:* with Resource:*.
guidance: Replace full-admin customer policies with scoped permissions.

title: Information Backup
description: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with an agreed backup policy.
guidance: Evidence: AWS Backup plans exist for critical resources. RDS instances have deletion protection enabled. DynamoDB tables have Point-in-Time Recovery enabled for continuous backup.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Availability of Information Processing Facilities
description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
guidance: Evidence: RDS instances are deployed with Multi-AZ for automatic failover and high availability. Single-AZ deployments create a single point of failure.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Management of Privileged Access Rights
description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights should be restricted and controlled. Root API calls must be exceptional and reviewed.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail event analysis detects root actor API calls. Direct user policy attachments bypassing group/role model are also monitored.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Information Access Restriction
description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy. S3 bucket policy/ACL changes and public access block removal must be monitored.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail event analysis detects S3 bucket policy changes, public access block removal, and other data exposure events.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Change Management
description: The organization shall control changes to information processing facilities, including Lambda function creation/modification.
guidance: Evidence: CloudTrail event analysis detects CreateFunction and UpdateFunctionConfiguration calls alongside other infrastructure changes.
iso_applicability_rationale: In scope: mapped to automated AWS evidence collection in Veritrail control catalog.

title: Control Environment — Integrity & Ethics
description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
guidance: Attest: code of conduct / ethics policy is published and acknowledged by personnel. Upload the policy and acknowledgment records.

title: Control Environment — Board Oversight
description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of internal control.
guidance: Attest: governance/oversight responsibilities are defined. Upload board or management-review evidence.

title: Control Environment — Structure & Authority
description: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.
guidance: Attest: org chart and role/responsibility definitions exist. Upload org chart.

title: Control Environment — Competence & HR
description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals — including hiring, background checks, and security training.
guidance: Attest: background-check policy, hiring process, and security-awareness training are in place. Upload policy + completion records.

title: Control Environment — Accountability
description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
guidance: Attest: responsibilities and accountability mechanisms (performance, disciplinary) are defined. Upload evidence.

title: Communication — Quality Information
description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control.
guidance: Attest: relevant security/operational information is captured and used. Upload sample reports/logs.

title: Communication — Internal
description: The entity internally communicates information, including security objectives and responsibilities.
guidance: Attest: security policies and responsibilities are communicated to personnel. Upload comms / onboarding materials.

title: Communication — External
description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.
guidance: Attest: process to communicate with customers/vendors/regulators exists (e.g. status page, trust center, DPAs).

title: Risk Assessment — Objectives
description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of related risks.
guidance: Attest: security/compliance objectives are documented. Upload objectives statement.

title: Risk Assessment — Identify & Analyze
description: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives and analyzes them as a basis for determining how to manage them.
guidance: Attest: a risk assessment / risk register exists and is maintained. Upload the risk register.

title: Risk Assessment — Fraud
description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
guidance: Attest: fraud risks are considered in the risk assessment. Upload evidence within the risk register.

title: Risk Assessment — Change
description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
guidance: Attest: change-impact assessment is part of risk/change processes. Upload evidence.

title: Monitoring — Evaluations
description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether controls are present and functioning.
guidance: Attest: internal audits / control self-assessments are performed (Veritrail's continuous scanning supports this). Upload audit cadence/evidence.

title: Monitoring — Deficiencies
description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those responsible for corrective action.
guidance: Attest: deficiencies are tracked and remediated (Veritrail findings support this). Upload remediation tracking.

title: Control Activities — Selection
description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives.
guidance: Attest: controls are mapped to risks. Upload control matrix.

title: Control Activities — Technology
description: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
guidance: Attest: technology general controls (access, change, ops) are defined — largely covered by Veritrail's automated checks.

title: Control Activities — Policies
description: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put policies into action.
guidance: Attest: a security policy set is published and maintained. Upload the policy set.

title: Logical & Physical Access — Physical
description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets to authorized personnel.
guidance: Attest: physical access is controlled (often inherited from the cloud provider's SOC 2 for data centers; office controls for the entity). Upload provider report + office policy.

title: Logical & Physical Access — Disposal
description: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data has been diminished (secure disposal).
guidance: Attest: secure media disposal / data destruction process exists. Upload disposal policy.

title: System Operations — Incident Evaluation
description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or did result in a failure to meet objectives, and if so, takes action.
guidance: Attest: a process to triage and evaluate security events exists (Veritrail anomaly detection + alerts support detection). Upload incident-evaluation procedure.

title: System Operations — Incident Response
description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.
guidance: Attest: an incident response plan exists and is tested. Upload the IR plan + any post-incident reviews.

title: System Operations — Recovery
description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.
guidance: Attest: backup and disaster-recovery procedures exist and are tested (Veritrail backup checks support this). Upload DR test evidence.

title: Risk Mitigation — Business Disruption
description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.
guidance: Attest: a business continuity plan and backups exist. Upload BCP + last DR test.

title: Risk Mitigation — Vendor Risk
description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.
guidance: Attest: vendors/subprocessors are inventoried and their security (e.g. SOC 2 reports) is reviewed. Upload vendor list + their reports.

title: Availability — Capacity Management
description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and to enable the implementation of additional capacity to help meet its objectives.
guidance: Evidence: capacity monitoring and scaling configuration. Automated AWS capacity checks are limited; attach monitoring dashboards or scaling policies as external evidence where applicable.

title: Availability — Backup & Recovery Infrastructure
description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet its objectives.
guidance: Evidence: AWS Backup plans, RDS automated backups and Multi-AZ configuration, DynamoDB point-in-time recovery, and deletion protection on stateful services.

title: Availability — Recovery Testing
description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its objectives.
guidance: Evidence: restore-test records and DR exercise results. Recovery testing is performed by your team; upload test reports or runbook execution records as external evidence.
